definitions.explanation: Contemporary poetry, especially free verse written in modern colloquial Japanese, as opposed to classical or fixed-form poetry such as tanka and haiku.

examples.japanese: {現代詩|げんだいし}を{読|よ}む。
{彼|かれ}は{現代詩|げんだいし}の{詩人|しじん}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as a poet of contemporary free verse.

examples.japanese: {現代詩|げんだいし}は{定型|ていけい}にとらわれず、{自由|じゆう}な{言葉|ことば}づかいで{書|か}かれることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Modern poetry is often written in free language, unbound by fixed forms.

notes:
Poetry written in modern colloquial Japanese, typically as free verse without fixed syllable counts. It contrasts with traditional fixed forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現代詩|げんだいし}を{書|か}く: to write modern poetry
- {現代詩|げんだいし}の{詩人|しじん}: a contemporary poet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {短歌|たんか}: tanka — fixed 5-7-5-7-7 form
- {俳句|はいく}: haiku — fixed 5-7-5 form
- {詩|し}: poem; poetry — the general word, of which {現代詩|げんだいし} is one type
